summary: PASS: the updated existing-repository pilot fixes the prior unsupported wiki:kit workflow contract, preserves the host service and adopter-owned policy, keeps the baseline delivery mismatch truthfully tracked by C-501, and passes the exact deterministic review binding.
evidence: Independently regenerated the pilot bundle and reproduced exact HEAD 914f56804ff034b10f3019fdbb8b27afc5b7bbd5, merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179, diff digest 3641516338ba49690a4d90e6a9b9ffec7c35b894a03c4e04aba6c2063cc00f44, and bundle digest 5c72fbc66812bfb75196c5c84c1894ea079dc40d7549b3d1e308bada0ba0007f.

Read the prior NEEDS_RECONCILE report, both exact bundles and metadata, installed AGENTS.md, wiki entrypoint/current status, product pages, source declarations, C-501, source/conflict maps, verification state, coverage, adopter policy, package scripts, workflows, hooks, and primary billing and delivery sources.

The upgrade from d5f3087e0312d85dc8e419bd1f02ae2921a06310 changes only .wiki/kit-manifest.json and wiki/WORKFLOW.md; host instructions, package policy, coverage/state/inventories, maps, product pages, C-501, wiki engine, and service sources remain byte-identical to that prior candidate, while all src files remain unchanged from the baseline.

Installed wiki/WORKFLOW.md contains no wiki:kit command; every bun run command in that workflow and installed GitHub workflows resolves to a script in package.json. Its sha256 200ac0e53e48561050591a6f3b5c8273cae9c5e04eb88b14814d16d00dbed046 matches the upgraded content-addressed manifest.

The reviewed pilot passed wiki:generated --check, wiki:lint, wiki:doctor, wiki:audit, wiki:check, metadata-enforced wiki:impact against the exact baseline, typecheck, and the complete 114-test suite with 516 assertions; work/search/context/conflict commands surfaced product/billing, product/delivery, and C-501 without inventing a resolution.

findings.discrepancy: The delivery implementation returns accepted while its adjacent intended-status contract declares queued.
evidence: Both values are present at merge base 45d4bd6fb8dccfb2c7f43546950ba66573dc6179 and remain byte-identical at the reviewed HEAD.
wiki/conflicts/open/C-501.md is open, declares conflict_type implementation and origin baseline, affects product/delivery, names both primary sources, and the metadata introduces C-501.
acceptance_criteria: An owner selects accepted or queued and implementation, contract, current page, and tests agree.

findings.discrepancy: The predecessor candidate installed publishing-only wiki:kit commands into a downstream workflow whose package exposed no wiki:kit script; the reviewed candidate removes those unsupported commands.
evidence: The reviewed wiki/WORKFLOW.md Before a PR block contains only commands present in package.json and contains no wiki:kit token.
The upgrade changes only the installed workflow and its content-addressed manifest entry, whose sha256 matches the reviewed workflow bytes.

The publisher regression fails against the merge-base kit because downstream workflow contains wiki:kit and passes at publisher HEAD f5c1a1d840c0b2fe08d322722ae9682587e589be, preventing this unsupported command from reappearing.
acceptance_criteria: The downstream Before a PR workflow names only commands that the adopted package actually exposes and supports under its non-publisher configuration.
Running the reconciled documented gate sequence reaches the implemented deterministic checks without a missing-script failure.
Publisher regression coverage prevents publishing-only wiki:kit commands from reappearing in an adopter workflow, and the pilot bundle is regenerated for the reconciled exact HEAD.
